card.name: "There" opening a no-information statement
card.fires_on: The word "There" starting the first sentence right after a section heading in a drug label, usually leading into "is no" or "are no" (no antidote, no studies, no information).

modes.label: Overdose antidote
modes.description: "There" opens the sentence under an overdose-management heading, followed by "is no specific antidote".
modes.example: 10.2 Overdose Management<< There>> is no known antidote for overdos

modes.label: Other section statements
modes.description: "There" opens a statement of absent data or tests under headings such as laboratory tests, elderly use or drug interactions.
modes.example: Laboratory Tests<< There>> are no routine laboratory tests recommended.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward Chinese words meaning "there is not any" and "has no", which fits a negation coming next.
card.plain: It marks the word "There" at the start of a label section that is about to say there is no antidote, data or test.
